ambiguities_or_notes: Tolstoy addresses Fet with the familiar contracted patronymic «Афанасьич»; the body preserves this as “Afanasich” rather than silently regularizing it to “Afanasyevich.”
The mixed Russian/German book title «Критика der reinen Vernunft» is rendered by its standard English title, “Critique of Pure Reason”; body_source_languages records the original German code-switch.

Tolstoy's slightly awkward New Year superstition sentence is kept structurally close: Fet's failure to come would mean being 'terribly disappointed by something' at the end of 1878, while his coming corresponds to being 'very glad.'
Footnote 1's «выслать за ним лошадей» is rendered as sending horses to fetch Fet at Kozlovka, preserving the purpose of the horses rather than merely saying they were sent there.
